name: n7-drawers (batch n7)
text: Part of the problem is that the Buddha (or the people writing his words down) stored the pieces of the puzzle in different drawers. For instance, he talks about direct sensations as the gateway in Ud 1.10, but explains how contact creates “the world” in a chain in SN 12.44. He talks about how consciousness and mind-and-body are like two bundles of reeds that lean against each other (remove one and the other falls down, Jenga!) in SN 12.67.
why: Emulate's sample cf with four fixes of mine, two from the reader's check (its first sentence is back to his flat opening, "Part of the problem is that the Buddha", which read AI, Low, in recheck 7 and on 2026-10-20)
